answer: To resist sybils, each agent must bond a stake before its beacon heartbeat counts, so every vertex in the trust graph is a deposit, not a free identity. The epoch reward is split pro rata across bonded stake, like a prism divides one pool, so an attacker minting N copies must fund N full stakes yet earns 1/N each, while any forged identity caught misbehaving is slashed, its bond burned as a direct financial loss.
